title: Fixed Two-Slot Bread Toaster
description: One original empty countertop bread toaster visual prop. A rounded-shoulder continuous body contains two genuinely deep separate top-loading rectangular bread wells with closed floors and full separating bridge. A real shallow vertical end recess supports a fixed stem and faceted grip. An integral base plate has four complete flat grounded feet. Four closed editable material meshes, three opaque untextured PBR materials. Metres, Z up, front -Y, horizontal-bounds-centred grounded soles. Newly authored complete appliance, not the old two-burner stove reduced in size or the front-loading vaulted bakery oven recoloured. No bread, heating wires, cord, electric circuit, pop-up spring or lever travel is modelled; no powered use, food-contact, heat or safety claim.
